plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Clavister firewall. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, sessions/connections, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 5089).
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the Clavister firewall since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Clavister firewall (CLAVISTER-MIB clvSysCpuLoad) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate inspection overload or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Clavister firewall (CLAVISTER-MIB clvSysMemUsage) as a 0-100 percentage. High memory pressure can degrade session handling.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used physical memory of the Clavister firewall in bytes (CLAVISTER-MIB clvSysMemUsedKiB, reported in KiB and scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free physical memory of the Clavister firewall in bytes (CLAVISTER-MIB clvSysMemFreeKiB, reported in KiB and scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: firewall_active_sessions
metrics.description: Number of current connections on the Clavister firewall (CLAVISTER-MIB clvSysConns). A rapid rise can indicate a connection flood or session-table pressure.
